prose: Why does Nathan Oakley say the globe needs a flat Earth? The author of Measured Flat: All Roads Lead to Flat Earth joins Chance Garton to explore his argument that the globe model depends on flat measurements. What does an elevation angle actually measure? Why do you level a compass, and why are north and up different directions? Nathan connects this to celestial navigation, sextants, Polaris, and the distinction between observation, calculation, and experimentation.
ext: Nearly an hour more on calculating the distance to the sun, gas pressure and containment, gravity, and the burden of proof. Nathan also turns his criticism toward Tartaria and mud-flood narratives.
